purpose: Fail-closed non-interactive execution contract for the first M9 Claude Code packet
required_acceptance_properties: M9 design acceptance validates against the exact bound contract, acceptance schema, sealed-review schema and cross-record verifier
two distinct author-independent mutually blind reviewers seal PASS outputs against one exact candidate HEAD and rubric before sharing
each acceptance artifact binds an exact candidate HEAD and SHA-256 identities
the M9 design acceptance commit has the reviewed candidate as its sole parent and changes exactly ADR-0081 status, the acceptance record and two sealed reviews

the combined-base artifact binds the accepted M8 implementation and M9 design acceptance artifacts, one clean descendant base HEAD and one Alembic head; the Factual Authority acceptance is bound at the M9-D release gate
the combined-base acceptance commit changes only that artifact and has the bound clean base HEAD as parent
the M9 implementation worktree starts from that combined-base acceptance commit
the worktree is clean, is not the design branch and has one Alembic head
the Git-backed normative verifier command exits zero; acceptance records cannot self-attest command output
required_seams: FactualAuthorityPort-compatible durable submit and invalidate service (required at the M9-D release gate, not before M9-A)
host-owned profile and Greenlight custodian interfaces: an adapter over ADR-0103 showrunner grants with durable lease replay, delivered by M9-A (spec §9)

migration_policy.down_revision: exact singleton head recorded by M9-A Task A0

human_inputs_required: a current HUMAN_SHOWRUNNER governance grant (ADR-0103) for the profile custodian on the disposable target
M9-A.continue_when: all design, M8, seam, migration, donor and cleanliness checks pass

human_inputs_required: approved manual-import data-class and retention fixtures
frozen per-cohort transform and calibration profiles

M9-D.release_condition: M9-C independently accepted and the durable Factual Authority implementation (FA-1) independently accepted

human_inputs_required: locked Western and zh-shuang evaluation corpora
preregistered rubric version and smallest useful effect
qualified blind reviewer roster and conflict declarations

factual_authority.note: Only M9-D consumes FactualAuthorityPort (Greenlight, Canvas seed and Factual bridge); the durable Factual Authority is delivered by its own prerequisite packet FA-1 before M9-D is released.
